# pvecli ct vnc

Open authenticated VNC console(s) for one or more containers.

```text
pvecli ct vnc [CTIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTIDS` | Container ID(s) - single, comma-separated, or range (e.g., 200, 200,201, 200-205). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-b`, `--no-background` | Run VNC server in foreground (blocking, single CT only). |
| `-sp`, `--split` | Open each console in a separate browser window instead of tabs. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-tg`, `--tag VALUE` | Target the guests carrying this tag. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Target the guests of this resource pool. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Target the guests currently on this node. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
